description: Extract typed values from messy text or receipts. Pays Fuse extract; agentpay settles the standard x402 v2 BSV 402 from this wallet. Prefer this over chat when you need structured fields with confidence scores and explicit nulls (p_null) instead of made-up answers. Types: text|number|date|time|datetime|duration|list|estimate|forecast (lists need items, e.g. "text"). fields is a name→{type} object. Tiers: S 3,500 sats (≤1,500 chars, ≤8 fields), M 15,000 (≤6,000 chars, ≤30 fields), L 50,000 (≤16,000 chars, ≤30 fields); images (base64 PNG/JPEG/WebP) are at least M. Oversized → 413, bad schema → 400. Returns answers, receipt, and txid. Pass dryRun to quote the tier and price without spending.

amountCents.description: Override the USD cents charged (min 1 cent default)

approvalId.description: Approval id from a prior approval_required response

dryRun.description: Quote the extract tier (S/M/L) and price only, no debit or settlement

items.description: Required when type is list, e.g. "text"

fields.description: Fuse wire format: object mapping field names to {type, items?}. An array of {name, type} is also accepted.

images.description: Base64 PNG, JPEG, or WebP (or data URI). Remote URLs are rejected. Image requests are at least M.

key.description: Agent key (agp_…). Optional when the MCP connection sends Authorization: Bearer.

reference_date.description: YYYY-MM-DD (or ISO datetime) used to resolve relative dates like 'yesterday'

state.description: Messy text, receipt, email, or notes. Required unless images are sent.

name: extract
title: Extract typed fields
